basics.name: Indrajit Kurmi
basics.label: Computer Vision Researcher
basics.summary: Computer Vision Researcher specializing in computational photography, synthetic aperture imaging, and machine learning applications for real-world challenges.

work.name: Johannes Kepler University
work.summary: Conducted research on synthetic aperture sensing using drones for occlusion removal and computer vision applications.
highlights: Developed airborne optical sectioning (AOS) for occlusion-prone environments.
Created autonomous drone for forest search and rescue with onboard deep learning.
Built Android app demonstrating AOS capabilities using DJI drones.
Designed drone swarms for sequential-parallel imaging and motion detection.

work.name: Indian Institute of Technology Kanpur
work.summary: Worked on computer vision and pattern recognition for anti-counterfeiting, 3D modeling, and industrial automation.
highlights: Developed pattern recognition for anti-counterfeiting using 3D tags.
Implemented total variation-based video restoration techniques.
Built advanced flight data analysis system for Hindustan Aeronautics Limited.
Developed welding seam detection using SVM for Welspun India.

work.name: Ericsson Global India (RFIC Firmware Developing Team, BMOD)
work.summary: Involved in development of firmware for RFIC chips within the baseband modem division.
